content: One who exercises sovereignty over their own senses fears nothing under the sun.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
explanation: Fear enters through the porous windows of unchecked desire: we fear loss because we cling to pleasure; we fear enemies because we crave approval. When the five horses of the senses are reined in by the steady charioteer of intellect, fear has no entry point.
practicalInsight: Consciously master one sensory temptation today—refuse the urge to gossip, indulge in sugar, or complain.
reflectionPrompt: What sensory addiction or compulsive attachment is making you vulnerable to anxiety and fear?
